cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at Izzat Ali Shah Hospital (IASH) between September 1, 2016 and December 31, 2017 with isolated pathogens on blood culture.
finding: The overall mortality rate among neonates with neonatal sepsis was 26%, with Klebsiella being the most common isolated pathogen, followed by Acinetobacter and E. coli, and the highest mortality rate observed with MRSA (60%).
mod_finding: Mortality in home-delivered babies was 38.5%, while mortality in babies born via vaginal delivery was 25% and 28% for those born via Cesarean section.
